# A book kept in CAD that holds US dollars, Hong Kong dollars and shares, with
# the prices GnuCash's own reports convert them by.
#
# Every top-level account is held in CAD, so the book is kept in CAD (Q-042).
# Beneath them:
#
# - Assets:USD Bank: 3,000.00 USD opened on 01-03, less 2,000.00 USD paid for
#   10 NASDAQ:AMZN on 01-04, plus 500.00 USD of consulting income on 01-20.
# - Assets:HKD Bank: 5,500.00 HKD opened on 01-03.
# - Assets:CAD Bank: 1,000.00 CAD opened on 01-03, less 100.00 CAD of fees on
#   01-21.
# - Assets:AMZN: the 10 shares, bought for 2,000.00 USD.
#
# Prices, all at 12:00 UTC: USD in CAD 1.30 on 01-02 and 1.40 on 02-02; HKD
# only the other way round, CAD in HKD 5.5 on 01-10; NASDAQ:AMZN in USD 210 on
# 01-15 and 220 on 02-15.
#
# What this fixture produces: the book above. GnuCash's Balance Sheet report as of
# 2026-01-25 values the USD at the 02-02 rate, its default price being the one
# nearest in time.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_statements_are_printed_by_customized_gnucash_reports.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	Equity:Opening CAD -1000.00 CAD

	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:AMZN 10.0000 AMZN
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
		share_price: "200"
		value: "2000.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -2000.00 USD

	Assets:USD Bank 500.00 USD

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Fees 100.00 CAD
